Name: Harvest Day Calendar
Author: azs7
Description:
[size=3]Harvest Day Calendar is a tool that aids you in organising and planning all of your harvests.

Press [color=#00ff00][b]﻿left shift + c[/b][/color] to open the calendar menu anywhere, anytime.

[url=https://ibb.co/n8NNLVYz][img]https://i.ibb.co/3Y99C8jB/Screenshot-2025-11-18-at-3-08-22-PM.png[/img][/url]

That's all!
[/size]

---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


Other things: 

1. [u]Current version:[/u] [url=https://github.com/shen02/StardewValley-Harvest-Day-Calendar/releases/tag/v1.1.2]1.1.2[/url]

2. [u]Current Features[/u]

- Navigates a calendar menu with the click of the keys left-shift and 'c' (the hotkeys are adjustable with Generic Mod Config Menu installed.)
﻿- Displays the most expansively-planted crop icon on the calendar grid on its day of harvest; 
﻿- Renders a hover menu detailing all available crop harvests, along with their planted quantity, in a day in the farmable locations of:
﻿ ﻿1. Pelican Town outdoor farm,
﻿ ﻿2. Greenhouse,
﻿ ﻿3. Ginger Island West. 
﻿- Automatically updates the date of next harvest after a regrowing crop is harvested. 

3. [u]Plans for Future Releases [/u]
﻿
﻿- Optimise UI scaling/dynamic rendering
﻿﻿- Integration with farms in map expansions
﻿- Check for multiple greenhouses

﻿Thank you to everyone who suggested!

4. [u]Installation[/u]
﻿
﻿Exactly the same with any other mod. Find your mod file path [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Player_Guide/Getting_Started]here[/url]. 
﻿ ﻿
﻿ ﻿1. Please make sure [url=http://smapi.io]SMAPI[/url] is successfully installed;
﻿ ﻿2. Download the .zip file from this mod's [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/39419?tab=files]download tab[/url];
﻿ ﻿3. Unzip and place in the mod file path of your operating system.

5. [u]Dependencies[/u]
﻿
[url=http://smapi.io]Stardew Modding API [/url]is required for this mod's functionality.

6. [u]Compatibility/Conflicts[/u] 

﻿ ﻿✅ Custom crops﻿ ﻿ ﻿  
﻿ ﻿ ﻿✅ Custom season
﻿ ﻿✅ Multiplayer

﻿This mod will function alongside mods that alter the number of days in a season, but may not render optimally as the current calendar menu is drawn with the dimensions of the vanilla background.
